accepted.rationale: The Go vulnerability database entry is unreviewed and module-wide; upstream it concerns Docker daemon plugin-install privilege validation (fixed in Engine 29.3.1). DCM links only the Docker SDK client/types, makes no plugin-install calls and embeds no daemon. No docker/docker SDK release carries a fix; operators patch the host Engine independently.

The Go vulnerability database entry is unreviewed and module-wide; upstream it concerns Docker daemon AuthZ plugins inspecting oversized bodies (fixed in Engine 29.3.1). DCM does not embed the daemon authorization-plugin server; only SDK client symbols are flagged. No docker/docker SDK release carries a fix; operators patch the host Engine independently.
